Changelog

boreholelabdata 1.0.1

  • Metadata-only release: CITATION.cff and inst/CITATION carry the Zenodo concept DOI and declare the work as a dataset; DESCRIPTION gains keywords, URL and BugReports; the pkgdown site is configured per the openwashdata standard and deployed from gh-pages; R CMD check runs in CI. The data are unchanged.

boreholelabdata 1.0.0

  • First release on Zenodo.
